Data Analyst

[SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - not a real vacancy]

Company: Maplecrest Health Partners
Location: Buffalo, NY
Work arrangement: Hybrid

About the team
Our analytics team turns clinical operations data into reporting that managers use every day.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI that track operational KPIs
- Write SQL queries to pull, clean and reconcile data from our relational databases
- Analyze trends and present findings to non-technical stakeholders
- Automate recurring reports and document data definitions
- Partner with operations managers to scope new reporting requests

What we're looking for
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or a related field
- 1-3 years of experience in a data analysis role
- Strong SQL skills
- Experience with Power BI or Tableau
- Working knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables
- Clear written and verbal communication

Nice to have
- Python (pandas) for analysis
- Experience with healthcare data
- A/B testing or statistics background
